Application Data.NAME: Smith Family Dental Practice
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: The Smith Family Dental Practice provides comprehensive dental care including preventive, restorative, and cosmetic dentistry services. Our operations encompass routine check-ups, teeth cleanings, orthodontics, and emergency dental treatments. We prioritize patient safety and satisfaction with a strong emphasis on infection control protocols and use of state-of-the-art sterilization equipment. The practice is equipped with modern dental technology to enhance patient care and comfort, and we maintain detailed records of all treatments provided. Our facility is secure, with a monitored alarm system in place, and we uphold a clean claims history, demonstrating our commitment to quality care and risk management.
